copy_missing_tensors_from_source: copy missing tensors like MTP layers from the original checkpoint into the quantized output directory
split_fused_expert_tensors: split 3D fused MoE expert tensors into per-expert 2D tensors for gate_proj and up_proj
quantize_weight_rtn: quantize a 2D weight tensor using round-to-nearest and pack into auto_gptq qweight qzeros scales format
woq_quantize_missing_tensors: apply weight-only quantization with RTN to missing Linear weight tensors using auto-round config
get_woq_config_from_dir: read the quantization config from config.json to get bits group_size and sym for auto-round packing
